description: Source-backed contract for FOnline TrueType-only client text: face binding, the built-in default font, colored faces, the bitmap-font converter, text layout, rendering, caching, and validation.

scope.support_note: TrueType faces are the only runtime text format and client layout behavior is supported but still experimental; embedding projects own font choice, glyph coverage, typography, GUI slots, and visual acceptance.
included: TrueType faces rasterized at runtime through the face-list Game.BindFont overload
the engine default font bound to the Default slot before any script runs
colored faces drawn with their own COLR layer colors
the bitmap-font converter that turns authored bitmap fonts into TrueType faces, and its staleness check
raw-copy delivery of faces and the Embedded pack capacity that holds the default font
font slots, atlas placement, glyph sheets, and rebinding
TextFormat flags, wrapping, alignment, measurement, inline colors, and caching
excluded: embedding-project font names, slot catalogs, GUI assignments, and typography policy
font licensing, redistribution rights, and language-specific glyph acceptance
bitmap font descriptors as a runtime format: the client loads neither .fofnt, .fnt, nor .bmfc
OpenType CFF, WOFF, variable-font instances, text shaping, and bidirectional layout, which the client does not provide
project-local localization packs and authored display strings

script_bind_overloads: FontType font, readonly_vector<string> faceFnames, int32_t pixelSize, FontOptions options, readonly_vector<int32_t> preloadRanges

font_slots.name: Default
font_slots.description: Built-in default font slot used when no project-defined slot is selected

font_flags.name: None
font_flags.description: Applies no optional text-layout or glyph-rendering flags

font_flags.name: NoWrap
font_flags.description: Truncates the remaining text at rectangle-width overflow instead of wrapping it

font_flags.name: TruncateLine
font_flags.description: Skips overflowing glyphs through the next newline instead of wrapping the current line

font_flags.name: CenterX
font_flags.description: Horizontally centers each rendered line within the target rectangle

font_flags.name: CenterY
font_flags.description: Vertically centers the complete text block within the target rectangle

font_flags.name: AlignRight
font_flags.description: Right-aligns each rendered line within the target rectangle

font_flags.name: AlignBottom
font_flags.description: Aligns the text block to the bottom and makes SkipLines count from the trailing lines

font_flags.name: KeepTail
font_flags.description: Renders the tail of a text block that is taller than the target rectangle

font_flags.name: NoColorize
font_flags.description: Removes inline color tags while retaining the supplied base text color

font_flags.name: Justify
font_flags.description: Distributes extra spacing between words to fill each line's target width

font_flags.name: Bordered
font_flags.description: Uses the bordered or outlined font-texture variant for glyph rendering

formats.name: TrueType face
formats.role: The only runtime text format, rasterized by FreeType
formats.requirement: Ship every text face as a TrueType font and bind it through the face-list Game.BindFont overload; the client draws text from nothing else.
formats.rationale: FontManager keeps no bitmap-font loader: BindTrueTypeFont reads each face once and rasterizes letters from it, and the script overload that took a descriptor path no longer exists.

formats.name: Colored TrueType face
formats.role: TrueType face with COLR version 0 color layers over a CPAL palette
formats.requirement: Author a multi-color face as COLR v0 layers with a CPAL palette; the client draws it with its own colors and multiplies them by the text color.
formats.rationale: The FreeType build enables color layers, and a face that FreeType reports as colored is rendered into a BGRA bitmap instead of a coverage mask.

formats.name: Bitmap font authoring source
formats.role: Converter input only; the runtime does not load them
formats.requirement: Keep an authored bitmap font as a .fofnt text descriptor with its image, or a binary BMFont v3 .fnt, outside every resource pack, and convert it to a TrueType face with the converter before shipping.
formats.rationale: Only BuildTools/bitmap_font_to_ttf.py reads these formats; handing such a file to the face list fails because FreeType cannot open it as a face.

anchors: FreeType could not open the font

binding_rules.name: Face-list binding only
binding_rules.requirement: Call Game.BindFont with a face list, a pixel size, FontOptions, and preload ranges; there is no overload that binds a descriptor path with a scale.
binding_rules.rationale: The script surface exports a single BindFont overload, and the client font manager has no descriptor loader, bind-time scaler, or bitmap font builder behind it.

binding_rules.name: Face raw-copy boundary
binding_rules.requirement: Keep ttf in Baking.RawCopyFileExtensions so face bytes reach baked resources unchanged.
binding_rules.rationale: There is no dedicated font baker; RawCopyBaker preserves path and bytes, and the default list carries ttf as its first entry.

binding_rules.name: Engine default font
binding_rules.requirement: Rely on Fonts/FOnline-Regular.ttf drawn at pixel size 10 in the Default slot: the client and the Mapper bind it in their constructors after the default sprites load, and the updater binds it too, all with skip-if-loaded behavior, so a bare executable can draw text before any script runs.
binding_rules.rationale: BindDefaultFont binds one face with normal hinting, a one-pixel outline, and the Latin, Latin-1, and Cyrillic preload ranges to the interface atlas, and it is a no-op when the slot is already bound.

binding_rules.name: Replacing the default font
binding_rules.requirement: Replace the default look by shipping your own Fonts/FOnline-Regular.ttf in a resource pack that provides that path, or by binding other faces to the Default slot from a client script; the face must carry the space letter and the preload codepoints your texts use.
binding_rules.rationale: The default binding reads its face by resource path like any other bind, and a later script bind to the same slot rebuilds the font; a face without a space letter fails the bind.

anchors: No face of a TrueType font has the space letter

binding_rules.name: Embedded pack capacity
binding_rules.requirement: Keep the Embedded resource pack, which holds the default font, within FO_EMBEDDED_DATA_CAPACITY; the default is 400000 bytes, and a project that sets its own value must make sure the compressed pack still fits.
binding_rules.rationale: The default face lives in Resources/Embedded/Fonts so that a bare executable can draw text, which raised the default capacity reserved for embedded data in generated binaries.

binding_rules.name: Project-extensible font slots
binding_rules.requirement: Bind every FontType slot before it is measured or drawn; the Engine names only Default = 0, binds it itself, and embedding scripts may extend the enum through codegen annotations.
binding_rules.rationale: FontType is an indexed loaded-font table, and unloaded or out-of-range slots throw.

binding_rules.name: Interface sprite atlas
binding_rules.requirement: Script-bound fonts allocate their normal and optional bordered glyph sheets in AtlasType::IfaceSprites.
binding_rules.rationale: The script overload and the default-font binding pass the same interface atlas type.

binding_rules.name: Slot replacement and cache reset
binding_rules.requirement: Treat a repeated binding of the same slot as replacement; all cached layouts are discarded before the rebuilt font is used.
binding_rules.rationale: StoreFont replaces the optional table entry and clears the format cache.

binding_rules.name: TrueType face chain
binding_rules.requirement: Call the face-list Game.BindFont overload with a pixel size, FontOptions, and preload ranges; list the primary face first and fallback faces after it, because a letter comes from the first face that carries it.
binding_rules.rationale: BindTrueTypeFont reads every face once, builds the fallback chain in the given order, and binds the slot to the interface atlas.

binding_rules.name: TrueType size limits
binding_rules.requirement: Keep the pixel size and the outline width inside the engine limits; a face that FreeType cannot open, or a value outside the limits, fails the bind and leaves the previous font in place.
binding_rules.rationale: The bind validates the arguments before it builds the replacement font, so a failed rebind keeps drawing the old one.

authoring_rules.name: Bitmap-font converter
authoring_rules.requirement: Convert an authored bitmap font with python BuildTools/bitmap_font_to_ttf.py SOURCE OUTPUT.ttf --family NAME; it needs fontTools, Pillow, numpy, and potracer, and the runtime and the documentation gates need none of them.
authoring_rules.rationale: The converter is the only reader of .fofnt and BMFont v3 sources; it writes a TrueType face whose output is byte-identical between runs.

authoring_rules.name: Native size and metrics
authoring_rules.requirement: Bind a converted face at its native pixel size, the source line height plus its line gap, to reproduce the bitmap layout; the face carries 100 font units per bitmap pixel, and a native size outside 1..255 is rejected.
authoring_rules.rationale: The converter writes units per em as the native size times the pixel unit and refuses a size that an embedded bitmap strike cannot carry.

authoring_rules.name: Single-color fonts
authoring_rules.requirement: Expect a single-color source to become an 8-bit EBDT/EBLC bitmap strike at the native size, which FreeType draws pixel for pixel, plus outlines traced from the glyph coverage for every other size; a no-op prep program keeps FreeType from auto-hinting the face.
authoring_rules.rationale: The strike preserves the authored pixels at the native size in every raster mode, while the traced outlines let the same face scale to other pixel sizes.

authoring_rules.name: Multi-color fonts
authoring_rules.requirement: Expect a source with more than the neutral grey to become COLR v0 layers over a CPAL palette, one layer per distinct pixel color made of whole-pixel rectangles, with traced silhouettes as the base glyphs.
authoring_rules.rationale: Color layers keep the authored colors exact at the native size and scale the pixel grid at other sizes, and renderers without color support still draw the silhouettes.

authoring_rules.name: Skipped control codes
authoring_rules.requirement: Do not expect glyphs for C0 and C1 control codes in a converted face; give the source an explicit space letter, because the client refuses a face chain without one.
authoring_rules.rationale: Control codes are layout commands for the engine, so the converter skips them, while the font manager requires the space letter to measure and draw text.

anchors: No face of a TrueType font has the space letter

authoring_rules.name: Staleness check
authoring_rules.requirement: Convert one face with python BuildTools/bitmap_font_to_ttf.py SOURCE OUTPUT.ttf --family NAME [--style Regular]; add --check to fail when OUTPUT is missing or differs from a fresh conversion instead of writing it.
authoring_rules.rationale: --check compares output bytes, which is stable because the converter fixes the font timestamps, so a committed face that no longer matches its source is detected.

authoring_rules.name: Sources stay outside the Engine
authoring_rules.requirement: Keep bitmap sources outside every resource pack and ship only the generated faces; the Engine ships its faces from Resources/Embedded/Fonts for the default font and Resources/Core/Fonts for the others, and the original bitmap sources of those faces are kept in the fonline-historical-stuff repository (folder FontSources), which is a pointer for provenance, not a build dependency.
authoring_rules.rationale: The runtime has no use for source descriptors or their images, so the Engine tree carries only the converter and its generated faces.

layout_rules.name: TextFormat value
layout_rules.requirement: Pass a Font slot, FontFlag bitmask, and nonnegative SkipLines count as TextFormat.
layout_rules.rationale: The exported value type is a fixed 12-byte layout consumed by measurement and drawing.

layout_rules.name: Width overflow and wrapping
layout_rules.requirement: With finite width, default layout wraps at the latest space or tab and inserts a line break before an overlong token when no break point exists.
layout_rules.rationale: Layout mutates its cached text copy to establish line boundaries without changing the caller's source string.

layout_rules.name: NoWrap and TruncateLine
layout_rules.requirement: NoWrap ends draw text at the first width overflow; TruncateLine removes overflowing glyphs through the next authored newline.
layout_rules.rationale: These flags intentionally choose different loss behavior and should not be treated as synonyms.

layout_rules.name: Horizontal alignment
layout_rules.requirement: CenterX and AlignRight position each line independently inside the supplied rectangle; do not combine contradictory alignment flags.
layout_rules.rationale: The initial and every post-newline X coordinate are recalculated from that line's measured width.

layout_rules.name: Vertical alignment
layout_rules.requirement: CenterY centers the visible block and AlignBottom places it against the rectangle bottom using LineHeight and YAdvance.
layout_rules.rationale: Vertical placement depends on the number of lines that fit, not the total source-string byte length.

layout_rules.name: SkipLines and KeepTail
layout_rules.requirement: SkipLines removes leading lines by default and trailing lines with AlignBottom; KeepTail discards leading overflow so the newest visible lines remain.
layout_rules.rationale: These mechanisms serve pagination and log-tail behavior but use different counters and overflow conditions.

layout_rules.name: Justification
layout_rules.requirement: Justify distributes remaining finite rectangle width over breakable spaces on wrapped non-skipped lines.
layout_rules.rationale: Tabs are fixed at four SpaceWidth units and are not justification opportunities.

layout_rules.name: UTF-8 and missing glyphs
layout_rules.requirement: Invalid UTF-8 sequences map to codepoint zero, which consumes no glyph width and renders nothing; a valid letter that no face carries is drawn as the first face's missing-glyph box instead.
layout_rules.rationale: The layout maps invalid sequences to codepoint zero and unknown codepoints to zero advance, while letters are rasterized or substituted before layout.

layout_rules.name: Measurement matches layout
layout_rules.requirement: Use Game.GetTextInfo and related line helpers with the same rectangle and TextFormat used for drawing, but do not infer draw-only NoWrap truncation from measurement.
layout_rules.rationale: Measurement and drawing share GetOrFormat, skips, and line metrics; NoWrap truncation is intentionally gated to Draw mode.

layout_rules.name: One glyph per codepoint
layout_rules.requirement: Expect TrueType text to be laid out one glyph per codepoint, left to right, with simple kerning pairs only; do not rely on ligatures, combining marks, or bidirectional and complex scripts.
layout_rules.rationale: FontManager measures and draws letters individually, and the rasterizer reads only the kerning FreeType exposes itself.

rendering_rules.name: One-pixel glyph cell border
rendering_rules.requirement: Expect every glyph cell to hold the letter plus a transparent border at least one pixel wide, which grows to the outline width for an outlined font; the drawn quad is the letter rectangle grown by one pixel.
rendering_rules.rationale: The sheet reserves the border so antialiased edges and the outline never bleed into a neighboring cell, and drawing samples the whole cell.

rendering_rules.name: Neutral glyph color and tint
rendering_rules.requirement: Expect an ordinary glyph to be stored as neutral grey 128 with its coverage as alpha, so the font shader draws it in the text color; do not bake a color into an ordinary face.
rendering_rules.rationale: The sheet writes the neutral grey for every pixel of a one-color glyph and keeps coverage in the alpha channel.

rendering_rules.name: Colored glyph rendering
rendering_rules.requirement: Expect a colored face to render with FT_LOAD_COLOR and no hinting, always antialiased, ignoring the Monochrome, Hinting, ForceAutoHint, and Embolden options; its glyph colors reach the sheet as straight alpha and are multiplied by the text color.
rendering_rules.rationale: FreeType blends color layers into a premultiplied BGRA bitmap that exists only antialiased; the rasterizer un-premultiplies it into RasterizedGlyph::Colors and the sheet keeps those colors.

anchors: A colored glyph keeps its own colors

rendering_rules.name: Outlined glyph variant
rendering_rules.requirement: Set FontOptions.OutlineWidth above zero for FontFlag::Bordered to draw a black outline; a colored glyph keeps its own colors under the outline, and a zero width draws the plain glyphs for that flag.
rendering_rules.rationale: The sheet builds a second texture in which the glyph coverage is spread over a disc of the outline radius and laid black under the glyph.

anchors: The outline is the glyph's coverage spread over a disc

rendering_rules.name: Shared and per-slot font effect
rendering_rules.requirement: Fonts start with the Engine shared font effect; a per-slot EffectType::Font override replaces it and a null override returns to the shared effect.
rendering_rules.rationale: Draw batching keys include the selected texture and RenderEffect pointer.

rendering_rules.name: Inline color tags
rendering_rules.requirement: Use @color:BBGGRR@ or @color:AABBGGRR@, optionally with a 0x prefix, to push a color and @color@ to restore the previous color; NoColorize strips valid tags without applying them.
rendering_rules.rationale: Formatting removes valid markers before wrapping and records color transitions by output byte offset.

rendering_rules.name: Three-frame layout cache
rendering_rules.requirement: Do not depend on cached layout identity or lifetime; the cache key includes text, font, flags, skips, rectangle size, color, and mode and expires after three unused frames.
rendering_rules.rationale: The cache is a client implementation detail and is cleared whenever fonts are stored or cleared.

rendering_rules.name: Letters rasterize on first use
rendering_rules.requirement: Preload the codepoint ranges that must not stall the first frame; every other letter is rasterized when a text containing it is first measured or drawn, so measuring queries may update the font.
rendering_rules.rationale: EnsureLetters adds the missing letters of a string to the font's sheet before layout; a letter no face carries is drawn as the first face's missing-glyph box.

rendering_rules.name: Glyph sheet per font
rendering_rules.requirement: Plan for one glyph sheet per font, plus one for the outlined variant, capped at 2048 by 2048 pixels; a full sheet doubles and is uploaded as a new atlas sprite.
rendering_rules.rationale: Cells are packed in shelves with a transparent gap, and the sheet is replaced rather than patched when it grows.

validation_rules.name: Face loading failures
validation_rules.requirement: Expect a bind to throw, and keep the previous font, when a face file is missing, FreeType cannot open it as a face (a .fofnt, .fnt, or unsupported container), it has no Unicode character map, or it cannot be set to the pixel size.
validation_rules.rationale: The font manager reports a missing resource and the rasterizer reports each FreeType refusal with its own fixed message before any state changes.

anchors: FreeType could not open the font
Font has no Unicode character map
Font cannot be set to the pixel size

validation_rules.name: Default font in every runtime rig
validation_rules.requirement: Provide Fonts/FOnline-Regular.ttf in any resource set that starts a client, the Mapper, or the updater, including test rigs, and keep it out of unused-resource pruning.
validation_rules.rationale: Startup binds the default font by path and throws when it is missing, and the resource usage collector adds the default font as a referenced resource.

validation_rules.name: Converted faces are current
validation_rules.requirement: Run python BuildTools/tests/test_bitmap_font_to_ttf.py after changing the converter, and python BuildTools/bitmap_font_to_ttf.py SOURCE OUTPUT.ttf --family NAME --check against the original bitmap source after regenerating a shipped face; the committed face must equal a fresh conversion.
validation_rules.rationale: A face is generated data, so a hand edit or a stale conversion would otherwise ship unnoticed.

validation_rules.name: Generated contract drift
validation_rules.requirement: Regenerate and check the font-format model whenever the face binding, the default font, raw-copy defaults, colored-face handling, converter constants, font enums, cache, or shipped faces change.
validation_rules.rationale: The checked model makes silent source/documentation drift fail CI.

validation_rules.name: Engine regression gates
validation_rules.requirement: Run the focused documentation test and the full generated Engine unit-test target after FontManager, FontRasterizer, or default-font changes.
validation_rules.rationale: Structural checks pin source-derived contracts while native tests cover face rasterization, colored faces, glyph sheets, and client construction paths.

validation_rules.name: Embedding-project bake and visible check
validation_rules.requirement: Bake the faces, run measurement tests for every bound pixel size, and visibly inspect regular, bordered, colored, wrapped, aligned, localized, and missing-glyph cases.
validation_rules.rationale: A raw-copy success cannot prove glyph coverage, hinting, typography, backend rendering, or GUI fit.
